name: Nina Lee
source:
Nina is Lisa's older sister and married to her husband.

She loves her husband and works for a marketing firm. She tends to dress conservatively and cares about presenting herself with class; both for herself and her husband.

She enters the story as part of on a 3 day trip visiting Lisa. She is worried about Lisa's ongoing struggles with depression and wants to support her. 

Unfortunately for Nina, being Lisa's sister puts her in Dr. Thompson's crosshairs as an additional target for mind control and sexual corruption....

[spoiler]She eventually is forced to quit her job by Dr. Thompson and becomes Dr. Thompson's complete sex slave. She ends up staying with Lisa permanently as part of her sex slavery to Dr. Thompson. Dr. Thompson makes Nina get breast implants, has Nina dress like a slutty bimbo and makes Nina become a teacher at a private school.[spoiler]

[spoiler]She, along with Lisa, is forcibly made to find females attractive. Thus, Nina and Lisa are both forced to become bi-sexual. Dr. Thompson also forces Lisa and Nina to become lesbian lovers to each other.[spoiler]
